messages.subject: Help files not showing up
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

 

I recently re-installed Eclipse and StatET, but ran into a problem.
Requesting for help to be printed from the console (either with 'help(".")'
or '?...' makes the focus move to the help window, but no help id displayed;
instead, the title bar of the window changes to 'No page at this time'.

 

StatET version is 3.3.2, Eclipse 3.8, Ubuntu 14.04, R 3.2.2.

 

Thanks for your help.

 

Edward
